description: TRIAL/PAID KEY: Get one compact chronological digest of wording changes recorded on ONLY your currently watched GOV.UK URLs since your previous saved cursor. Start since=0; save next_cursor and send it next time. Safe idempotent retry: reading never advances cursor. Handles A-to-B-to-A reversions; first baseline is NOT a change. No push alert or automatic trial-to-paid transfer.

api_key.description: Optional UKSI API key (usi_...). Prefer supplying Authorization: Bearer KEY in MCP connection settings rather than exposing paid keys in tool calls.

since.description: Last event cursor received, or 0 initially. Optional; defaults to 0.

name: my_watch_changes
